user.title: Connect to Moonraker
user.description: Enter the address of the printer's Moonraker API.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the printer.
data_description.name: Optional. Defaults to the printer's hostname.
data_description.api_key: Only needed if Moonraker requires authorization for this network.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Moonraker at that address.
error.invalid_auth: Moonraker rejected the request. Check the API key.

data_description.web_url: Base URL for relative webcam addresses, e.g. http://192.168.1.20 or http://192.168.1.20:4408. Defaults to http://HOST, where HOST is the printer's address.
data_description.stream_source: Optional. Any source Home Assistant's go2rtc understands (rtsp://, webrtc:..., ffmpeg:...). Replaces the cameras from Moonraker. Creality WebRTC cameras are detected automatically.
data_description.macros: Each selected macro becomes a button. Macros starting with _ are hidden.
